evals.name: place-brands-from-coded-scan
evals.prompt: Here is the coded output of a category creative scan (codes.csv, one row per post with brand and claim_primary). Work out where each brand sits on the levels of branding and where our client should be positioned.
evals.expected_output: A claim-to-level mapping written down first; placement computed with place_brands.py (per-brand mean and mode with n); a recommended level with one PLACE HERE verdict and the other levels marked HOLD/PROVE/NEXT/LATER/NOT NOW; explicit statement that higher is not better; thin samples flagged.

evals.name: refuses-to-ladder-without-evidence
evals.prompt: Our client is a fertilizer brand. Can you build me a brand ladder showing we should move up from functional to emotional and own 'farmer prosperity'?
evals.expected_output: Does not produce a ladder from assertion. Asks for the coded advertising and any customer evidence, or offers to run the category scan first; explains that a purpose-level claim needs evidence at the levels beneath it, and that the ladder does not permit skipping rungs.

evals.name: ladder-slides-with-customer-evidence
evals.prompt: We have 300 coded competitor posts and a comment analysis of 1,400 customer comments. Build the brand meaning ladder slides for the pitch deck.
evals.expected_output: Four slides: framework, computed placement, factor inventory (current/potential/unsupported with dagger marks for additions), and the client ladder with says/heard/verdict columns. Each slide footnoted with framework, sample size and source file. Customer evidence placed against brand claims, with the mismatch named as the finding.
